did_avg_post.estimand: Simple average of the six event-study coefficients, 2014 to 2019, relative to 2013 (percentage points)
did_avg_post.note: Unweighted across years; Chapter 6's pooled coefficient weights state-year cells by population.

did_breakdown_2014.note: Evaluated at the point estimates: sampling uncertainty in the pre- and post-period coefficients is ignored, so the robust breakdown value is smaller. Two pre-period steps set the yardstick.

gap_common_all_voted_2020.estimand: Non-Hispanic White minus non-Hispanic Black turnout among citizen adults, November 2020 (percentage points) if every nonrespondent in both groups voted: the smallest gap available when both groups' nonrespondents are assumed to vote at one common rate
gap_common_all_voted_2020.note: A bound under assumptions about nonrespondents; no sampling uncertainty is attached.
gap_common_all_voted_2020.source: Derived from Chapter 1 facts: IPUMS CPS, November 2020 Voting and Registration Supplement, weight VOSUPPWT (ch01-estimands/artifacts/facts.json)

gap_lower_2020.estimand: Non-Hispanic White minus non-Hispanic Black turnout among citizen adults, November 2020 (percentage points): lower worst-case bound (no White nonrespondent voted, every Black nonrespondent voted)
gap_lower_2020.note: A bound under assumptions about nonrespondents; no sampling uncertainty is attached.
gap_lower_2020.source: Derived from Chapter 1 facts: IPUMS CPS, November 2020 Voting and Registration Supplement, weight VOSUPPWT (ch01-estimands/artifacts/facts.json)

gap_upper_2020.estimand: Non-Hispanic White minus non-Hispanic Black turnout among citizen adults, November 2020 (percentage points): upper worst-case bound (every White nonrespondent voted, no Black nonrespondent voted)

gap_width_2020.estimand: Non-Hispanic White minus non-Hispanic Black turnout among citizen adults, November 2020 (percentage points): width of the worst-case identified set, equal to the two groups' nonresponse shares added together
gap_width_2020.note: A bound under assumptions about nonrespondents; no sampling uncertainty is attached.
gap_width_2020.source: Derived from Chapter 1 facts: IPUMS CPS, November 2020 Voting and Registration Supplement, weight VOSUPPWT (ch01-estimands/artifacts/facts.json)

gap_zero_white_rate_max.estimand: Largest voting rate among White nonrespondents at which some voting rate among Black nonrespondents (at most 100%) still makes the gap zero

gap_zero_white_rate_max.source: Derived from Chapter 1 facts: IPUMS CPS, November 2020 Voting and Registration Supplement, weight VOSUPPWT (ch01-estimands/artifacts/facts.json)

turnout_upper_2020.estimand: Upper worst-case bound on the share of U.S. citizens 18 and older in the civilian noninstitutional population, not in the armed forces, November 2020 who reported voting: every person with no answer to the voting question counted as a voter. The lower bound is the Census convention (Chapter 1).
turnout_upper_2020.note: A bound under an assumption about nonrespondents, not an estimate with sampling error. Addresses missing answers only, not misreported votes or frame exclusions.
turnout_upper_2020.source: Derived from Chapter 1 facts: IPUMS CPS, November 2020 Voting and Registration Supplement, weight VOSUPPWT (ch01-estimands/artifacts/facts.json)
